name: @baryodev/barako-client
description: Typed TypeScript client for the barakoCMS headless API. Framework-agnostic (Node, browser, edge), API-key or JWT auth with refresh, tenant handling, and typed content/schema resources.
author: BaryoDev

scripts.build:lib: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsup
scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build -w cli
scripts.test: vitest run src && npm test -w cli
scripts.test:int: npm run build && vitest run --config cli/vitest.int.config.ts
